# Trump approval reaches record low in new survey

#### 

#### 

President Trump’s approval rating for his second term has reached a new low, according to a new poll.

In the Reuters/Ipsos poll, the president’s approval rating hit 33 percent, a 14-point slide from the start of his second term, when it was at 47 percent, and a 4-point slide from about a month ago, when it was at 37 percent.

# Trump approval rating falls to new low in Mississippi, US polls

Mississippi has long been one of President Donald Trump's strongest states. But new polling shows support for the president has weakened since the start of his second term.

His approval has been stuck at a record low nationally for three weeks. In Mississippi, a rising disapproval rating means his numbers have been underwater for the last two months, and the gap is getting wider.
